# Singer Identity inference source

This directory vendors the minimal inference files from
`SonyCSLParis/ssl-singer-identity` at revision
`24751d11c6c169adc53be906fd36560df447f974`.

The upstream project is distributed under the MIT License. See `LICENSE`.
Model weights are downloaded from `BernardoTorres/singer-identity` by
`setup_recommender.py` and verified with a pinned SHA-256 digest.
